title: Career design
learning_outcomes: Explain skills and constraints in the context of career design.
Compare and distinguish role research in the context of career design.
Apply career experiments in the context of career design.
Evaluate and justify decisions about development plan in the context of career design.

lessons.title: Skills and constraints
lessons.outcome: Explain skills and constraints in the context of career design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving skills and constraints; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to career options portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain skills and constraints from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of skills and constraints; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Role research
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish role research in the context of career design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving role research; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to career options portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain role research from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of role research; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Career experiments
lessons.outcome: Apply career experiments in the context of career design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving career experiments; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to career options portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain career experiments from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of career experiments; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Development plan
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about development plan in the context of career design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving development plan; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to career options portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain development plan from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of development plan; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of skills and constraints; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of role research; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of career experiments; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of development plan; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
